subject: Is this still on your roadmap? Recap + quick asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Li <jared@novatech.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync: Inference use case recap + next step

Hi Jared —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick written recap so we have the same page and a very small ask below.

Recap from today's call (by priority):
- Primary use case: customer support triage + summarization for incident tickets (~1.2M tickets/year).
- Success metric: reduce TTR (time-to-resolution) for Level 1 by 25% with <>90% accuracy on intent classification.
- Data constraints: PII redaction required; logs retained on-customer VPC.
- Ops: would prefer Dedicated capacity or Private (VPC) deployment for initial pilot.

What I can offer next: a short pilot plan (4-week, 2-model variants, SLA targets + E2E cost estimate) and a lightweight security checklist for your compliance team. I attached a one-page capture of our discovery notes.

Two small asks — one of these is fine:
1) Quick fit feedback: does the above capture the right priority and constraints? A one-line reply is perfect.
2) If yes, pick a 30-min slot next week for a pilot scope/ops sync and I'll bring the engineer who can map architecture.

If this is not a priority right now, a one-line "not now" is also very helpful for my planning.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

Attachments: discovery-notes-20280528.pdf (summary of call, anonymized examples)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Li <jared@novatech.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Following up: Quick sync: Inference use case recap + next step

Hi Jared —

Wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Two minutes to confirm one of the asks would help me pick the right next step:
- "Sounds right" (we'll send pilot plan)
- "Schedule" (I can propose 3 times)
- "Not now" (I'll circle back in a few weeks)

If helpful, we can also do a short recorded walkthrough of the pilot plan instead of a live call.

Thanks — appreciate any direction.
Marissa

From: Jared Li <jared@novatech.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Following up: Quick sync: Inference use case recap + next step

Hey Marissa —

Sorry for the delay and thanks for the clear recap. We had an internal budget freeze this quarter, so we need to deprioritize new pilot work for a bit.

The use case is still interesting but not actionable for us until finance lifts the freeze. Please keep us on your radar; I'd be open to a short check-in once budgets are clearer.

Best,
Jared Li
VP Product, Novatech
jared@novatech.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Li <jared@novatech.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Following up: Quick sync: Inference use case recap + next step

Thanks for the update, Jared — totally understand. Two quick asks so I can follow up appropriately:

1) If you have 30 seconds, could you share one-line feedback on fit (e.g., "promising", "not a fit", "needs more privacy work")? That helps our prioritization and the right internal follow-up.
2) Would it be okay if I check back in ~6 weeks? If budgets are still locked, a short "still frozen" is fine and I'll pause outreach.

If useful, here's the pilot one-pager and an architecture sketch we discussed: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PilotProposalNovatech (view only).

Appreciate it — I'll stand by and coordinate timing on our end.

Warmly,
Marissa
